# Backtest

From 3,430 runs (3,383 completed) in 293 sessions across 21 projects, 2026-W40 to 2026-W45, from 1 contributor. The largest project holds 67% of runs and the three largest sessions hold 45%.

Reproduce with `agentpace backtest` (seed 20261107). Forecasts use only `model`, `task_kind` and `risk` unless a track says otherwise.

![P80 coverage by method](assets/backtest-coverage.svg)

Reading the columns: MAPE is the mean percentage error of the P50, which heavy tails inflate. MdAPE is its median. MALE is mean absolute log error. Coverage is how often the actual run landed at or under that forecast. P90/P50 is the median width of the range. Pinball is in seconds, summed over 0.5, 0.8 and 0.9.

## Which method ships

The rule was fixed before any result existed: lowest session-weighted pinball loss, summed over 0.5, 0.8 and 0.9, on the time split, with ties inside the 95% session-bootstrap interval going to the simpler candidate. Selection uses weeks up to 2026-W45 and never re-runs on later ones.

Selection, the time-split tables and the whole-session test score `claude-code` sessions only, the population the rule was frozen on. Rows from every harness train the estimator. This scope was registered on 2026-11-07, after a local run with Codex rows pooled in had been seen.

| Candidate, simplest first | Loss | Difference from lowest (95% interval) |
|---|---:|---|
| global | 1276 | +118 to +355 |
| kind | 1496 | +320 to +596 |
| backoff | 1364 | +157 to +523 |
| shrunk | 1047 | -17 to +24 |
| weighted | 1044 | lowest |

**Winner: `shrunk`.** It is the default for `agentpace estimate`.

## Whole sessions (oracle-structure)

Each of 56 held-out sessions with at least 5 completed runs is treated as a plan. This is the only direct test of plan totals. Real dependencies are not recorded, so the critical path falls back to the longest run, and the observed peak concurrency stands in for the agent cap, even though that peak is itself an outcome. It tests the throughput and session terms, not dependency planning.

| Method | MAPE | MdAPE | MALE | P50 cov. | P80 cov. | P90 cov. | P90/P50 | Pinball |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| agentpace | 249% | 67% | 1.02 | 59% | 80% | 91% | 2.7x | 19720 |
| sum-of-medians | 85% | 90% | 2.25 | 5% | 5% | 5% | 1.0x | 37990 |

With 95% bootstrap intervals over sessions: P50 coverage 59% (CI 45% to 71%), P80 coverage 80% (CI 70% to 91%), P90 coverage 91% (CI 84% to 98%), pinball 19720 (CI 13260 to 28000). Sum-of-medians pinball minus agentpace: +7271 to +31170.

## Locked holdout

Weeks after 2026-W45 never take part in selection. They score the shipped `shrunk` on data it was not chosen on. Results print once at least 20 held-out sessions have 5 or more completed runs.

**Not enough data (no weeks after 2026-W45 yet).**

## Baselines

- `human-guess`: a hand-written table of hours per kind. An assumption, not a measurement.
- `fixed-rounds`: 3 minutes per round, with rounds from a hand-written table per kind.
- `rounds-oracle`: 3 minutes times the actual `tool_calls`. It uses the answer, so no forecast could do this. It is shown anyway.
- `global-median`: the training median, for every run.

Baselines give one number, used for every quantile, so their P90/P50 is always 1.0x.
